title: Monotonicity of the uniform norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $0<p\le q$, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then the uniform $L^p$ norm of $f$ is at most its uniform $L^q$ norm.
